# Chapter Main Points

The SQL training has incredible amounts of definition between key words, concepts, and differences particularly the differences between a data base and being able to extract specific data from the entity of information provided.

| ***Databases***
| System for managing data that allows us to store data reliable; retrieve information efficiently, and manipulate data systematically.

| Power web, mobile, and other applications as well as data analysis and reporting.

## SQL Basics

- Structured Query Language

- Allows for researchers to use column and row specific language in order to extract particular amounts of data

- This allows researchers to process information clearly and be able to present specific findings to others

- SQL is a language all about working with data

## Major SQL Foundations

> ```sql
> SELECT column_1, column_2
> FROM table_1
> ```

Each column and table will be labeled depending on what the researcher is currently trying to extract.

> ```sql
> SELECT column_1, column_2
> FROM Table_1
> ORDER BY column_1 DESC
> ```

DESC will present the information in DESCending order!

Although these functions are simple; they surprisingly have such power from the databases that allows researchers to seamlessly be able to extract, digest, and be able to present specific data.
